answers.1_per_source_session_owner_required: YES — SourceAccessBroker is correctly decode-scoped, and the per-source expectations cannot be enforced at that scope. VERIFIED: two successive decodes of the same source each built their own broker and BOTH succeeded, aggregating to path_opens=2, hash_passes=2, metadata_reads=2 with no refusal. The missing owner belongs ABOVE _decode.
answers.2_lifecycle_boundary: ONE bound source ENTRY of the warrant execution surface (source_key + canonical_sha256 + format + operation plan), not one _decode() call. This is the only boundary at which the frozen PER-SOURCE expectations can be aggregated and enforced.
answers.3_decoder_invocations_separate_counter: YES — a separate mandatory O1-C07 account that is ABSENT today from both the account and the budget. It cannot be relabelled from reader_invocations: one decoder entry performs several reader invocations (measured metadata_reads=1 + full_reads=1 = reader_invocations=2 for one decoder entry).
answers.4_which_classes_admit_a_header_prefix: ONLY SRC26. Every other class omits it, and a 512-byte DTA header read is an invention. VERIFIED: a decode of a source whose class admits no header prefix still reported header_prefix_reads=1/bytes=176.
answers.5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only_forbids_full: YES — their class admits 'a metadata-only reader probe' with expected_full_reads=0. VERIFIED hazard: a declared-encoding source with no selected set routes to broker.full_read and reported full_reads=1. The budget gate can refuse it (full_reads=0 -> SOURCE_ACCESS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) but no per-source plan sets it.
answers.6_SRC27_multiple_path_level_opens: DESCRIPTIVE, not binding. The later hardened note states the governing minimum as four LOGICAL OPERATIONS and never requires multiple opens; O1-C07 demands separate ACCOUNTING per layer, not separate descriptors. 'Will involve' is predictive mood.
answers.7_does_one_open_conflict_with_SRC27: NO. VERIFIED on a declared-encoding DTA carrier: existence_checks=1, hash_passes=1, metadata_reads=1, full_reads=1 over path_opens=1 — the hardened-note minimum is met over one open.
answers.8_SRC27_one_pass_requires: exactly ONE full read AND exactly ONE decoder entry; it does NOT require one reader invocation (metadata + full read = 2) and capping reader invocations at 1 would forbid the mandatory metadata read.
answers.9_MAX_1_decoder_invocation_lawful: YES — as a typed AUTHORIZATION/policy ceiling with a stated rationale, never filed under an expected_/observed_ key. The accounting law already uses that pattern (policy ceilings that 'STOP a run', frozen retries=0 with rationale disclosure).
